description_text: To coordinate and implement citywide efforts aimed at reducing disparities related to the Social Determinants of Health (SDH) for African American and Latino males ages 1424. The initiativeThe Mens Wellness Initiativewill focus on promoting mental health, increasing access to healthcare services, and fostering overall well-being among young men and their families throughout New York City.
